$comment: Line's ONE set of per-step AI profiles (contract: StepProfile in packages/engine/line/contract.mjs). Cockpit's LLM capabilities (ui/server settings llmProviders), Trace's AI tasks (trace/ai.config.json holds only model overrides) and the picker all read their model, reply cap and ladder from here. The ladder is static -> middleware -> Line-1 (the one picker; jev fills that role until Line-1 ships) -> Construct verify -> person. The profile is the only switch: a step's model rung (ladder.options.on) runs only when it is on AND ladder.measured records its win over static; otherwise the step ships off and static answers. onRequest steps run only when the person asks (a button, a chat, or turning AI on for a Trace run), never by themselves. Local models only: nothing here pulls or stops a model.

profiles.label: Suggests the next step a developer most likely wants from the steps on offer.
profiles.guidance: Pick the next step a developer most likely wants from the offered steps.
profiles.question: Which step does the developer most likely want next?

profiles.label: After Construct refuses a change, picks which of its typed fixes to try next.
profiles.guidance: Construct refused the change; pick the typed fix that resolves the refusal. The first fix is Construct's recommended one.
profiles.question: Which fix resolves the refusal?

ladder.measured: 2026-10-11 qwen2.5-coder:1.5b, 10 refusals: with the refusal sentence and typed fixes 9/10, static (Construct's recommended fix) 6/10.

profiles.label: When Construct refuses a change, the local model repairs it from the exact error and its typed fixes, up to 4 tries that each learn from the last; if Construct still refuses it, you decide.
profiles.guidance: Construct refused this change. Change only what the error and its typed fixes say, and answer with the corrected change in the same shape.

ladder.measured: 2026-10-12, 20 seeded Train Line refusals: 1.5B repair loop without a reason 7/20 (static repairs 0/20; ~0.3 s). 1.5B one attempt 7/20; loop with a reason 5/20; 7B loop with a reason 4/20, without 8/20 (~1 s). Re-measure after the nearest-match typed fix merges; switch to the 7B only if it then clearly wins.

profiles.label: Recalls past decisions also by meaning: a local embedding model compares the slotted words of your past decisions, never your code; the Memory tab's switch turns it on for a project.
profiles.modelFrom: an embedding model, chosen for this step

profiles.label: Labels where static code missed, offline: picks the right option for each miss, or none fits, so new static rules can be proposed.
profiles.guidance: Static code missed this decision. Pick the option that was right, or none fits when no option is right.
profiles.question: Which option was right?

profiles.label: Picks where one part of a page gets its data from, citing a fact that settles it.
profiles.guidance: Pick the option the cited facts support; never static text.
profiles.question: Which option do the facts support?

ladder.measured: 2026-09-29 (LIN-110) qwen2.5-coder:1.5b on the Trace eval corpus: 78/132 answered, 60% of those correct; no win over static measured yet, so it ships off.

profiles.label: Picks the API fields that feed one part of a page.
profiles.guidance: Pick every field the cited facts support.
profiles.question: Which fields feed this part?

profiles.label: Writes one expression for a placeholder, kept only when it reproduces the design's examples.
Puts an open item in plain words for the run summary, checked against its facts.
Rewrites a team email on request; every draft is fact-checked and never sent by itself.
Answers questions about one part in the Part inspector, fact-checked and never applied by itself.
Proposes one sample value for a contract field that has no example.
Proposes a page story with a goal and acceptance points, never saved by itself.
Fills one imported file's gaps, shown as a diff you approve.
Fills a newly created unit's body, shown as a diff you approve.
